segments.content: WLOG sort a₁ < a₂ < ... < aₙ (by applying a permutation)——通过排列归约到已排序情形
Let x = a₁ + ... + a_{n-1} (sum of all but the largest element)——定义关键变量x为除去最大元素的和
features: aₙ的最大性-排除最大元素

segments.content: We proceed by strong induction on n——对n做强归纳
Three cases based on the position of M's elements relative to x——按M中元素相对x的位置分三种情况
Case 1 (x ∈ M and ∃ y ∈ M with y > x): Then n ≥ 3——Case 1条件：x在M中且M中有元素大于x，推出n≥3
Among the n-1 small elements, define 'bad' index i if x - aᵢ ∈ M or s - aᵢ ∈ M——定义bad index概念
The map from bad indices to M\{x} is injective (x - aᵢ maps to M\{x} since x ∈ M and aᵢ > 0; s - aᵢ > x so maps to M∩(x,∞))——证明bad index到M\{x}的单射映射
Since |M\{x}| = n-2, there are at most n-2 bad indices among n-1 total, so at least one good index r exists with x - aᵣ ∉ M and s - aᵣ ∉ M——鸽巢论证得出good index r存在
Let t = x - aᵣ, M' = M ∩ (-∞, t]——定义t和缩减禁集M'
Then |M'| ≤ n-3 (since both x and y are excluded from M')——估计M'的规模上界
Apply induction to the n-2 remaining elements (excluding aᵣ and aₙ) with M', getting permutation p'——对剩余元素和M'应用归纳假设
features: aₙ的最大性-排除最大元素

segments.content: Construct the full permutation: place p' first, then aᵣ, then aₙ (with a swap to put aₙ second-to-last)——构造完整排列，使用swap技巧
All prefix sums before aᵣ are ≤ t and avoid M'; the sum up to aᵣ is s - aₙ = s - aᵣ - (sum of rest) which avoids M by choice of r; the final sum is s ∉ M——验证Case 1构造的正确性
Case 2 (x ∉ M and ∃ y ∈ M with y > x): Then |M ∩ (-∞, x]| ≤ n-2——Case 2条件：x不在M中且M中有元素大于x，估计规模
Let M' = M ∩ (-∞, x]——定义Case 2的缩减禁集M'
Apply induction to a₁,...,a_{n-1} with M' (sum = x ∉ M')——对前n-1个元素和M'应用归纳假设
If M' is empty, use identity——M'为空时的边界情况处理
Otherwise get permutation p', extend by placing aₙ last——非空时获得p'并把aₙ放最后
All prefix sums of first n-1 jumps are ≤ x and avoid M'; the final sum is s ∉ M——验证Case 2构造的正确性
Case 3 (all m ∈ M satisfy m ≤ x): Let z = max(M), M' = M\{z}——Case 3条件：M中元素都≤x，定义z和缩减禁集M'
Apply induction to a₁,...,a_{n-1} with M' (|M'| = n-2). Get permutation p'——对前n-1个元素和M'应用归纳假设
If some prefix sum of p' equals z at position k, swap position k with the last position: place aₙ at position k (jumping over z since aₙ > a_{p'(k)}), and place a_{p'(k)} last——若p'的前缀和命中z则用swap技巧跳过z
If no prefix sum equals z, p' already avoids all of M (since M = M' ∪ {z} and z is never hit)——若p'未命中z则p'已避开整个M
The general case (unsorted a) is reduced to the sorted case by composing with the sorting permutation——一般情形通过合成排序置换归约到已排序情形
